paragraphs.text: Strata local inference provider and model manager for DeepSeek Harness
# Strata for DSH
A local model provider for DeepSeek Harness. **0.6.0** identifies built-in MTP and supports selectin
g or automatically preparing a separate Flash-Next MTP runtime. It automatically downloads the verif
ied Strata runtime after a GitHub installation. It separates Models, Files and Activity into focused
views. Each model has a Settings view that opens in place, with Load beside it. Strata supports nat
ive SSD checkpoints and a top-level Purge all cache button.
## Install
Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** Web profile, Node **22.19+**, and `pnpm` on DSH's PATH. The included eng
ines target **Linux x86-64, NVIDIA Blackwell sm_120, CUDA 13, glibc 2.43 or newer**. Other GPUs and
operating systems have not been validated with this bundle.
Download the `.tgz` from Releases, then enter its absolute local path in **Plugins → Add plugin**. E
nable it and open **Settings → Models**. Strata, portable Python, CUDA libraries, the GGUF helper an
d the Gyro L fork are included. Model weights are separate. No compiler or separate Strata installat
ork are included. Model weights are separate. No compiler or separate Strata installation is needed.
The GitHub address is also accepted by DSH:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A GitHub source installation automatically downloads and verifies the runtime from this repository w
hen the plugin is enabled. Progress appears in the Strata card; if it fails, use Retry installation.
Prefer the release archive for an offline installation. Updating an existing plugin requires uninst
alling and reinstalling it, restarting DSH, then reloading the browser page. Profiles and original w
eights are retained in the plugin's data directory.
## Import models
1. Choose **Import files**, then select any shard or a folder. The host file picker works on the DSH

machine, including mounted drives.
2. The importer recursively reads GGUF headers and groups shards
. **Files** lists complete models, incomplete sets, each file's purpose and its size. Original weigh

ts stay where they are.
3. A single vision projector under the model folder is selected automaticall
y. Otherwise choose **Select mmproj file** or **Continue without vision**. Strata checks compatibili

ty when loading.
4. Choose **KV precision (K / V)** and **Context**, then **Save and auto-tune**. Co
ntext defaults to **Native**, using the model's declared GGUF context. Smaller choices remain availa

ble in **32,768-token increments**. Saved explicit choices are retained.
5. When tuning finishes, ch
oose **Load** and select the model in DSH's conversation picker.
The KV choices are **FP16/FP16, FP16/Q8, Q8/Q8, Q8/Q5, Q5/Q5, Q5/Q4, Q4/Q4**. Unsupported choices ar
e disabled. The importer never silently substitutes precision. The bundled TQP fork is selected auto
matically for Gyro L's TQP5/6/7 encodings; Gyro S uses the regular Strata engine. Explicit runtime o
verrides remain available under **Advanced**.
Control-vector GGUFs appear under **Files → Components**, never as loadable models. Earlier accident
al vector profiles are preserved in `component-profiles.json` and removed from model routes; origina
l GGUF files are untouched. **Select** reveals bulk tuning controls. Logs remain under **Activity**.
## Thinking presets
The conversation selector offers **Low**, **Medium**, **High** and, for compatible original Flash-Ne
xt models, **Uncensored**. The native requests are `low`, `medium`, `xhigh`, and `xhigh` with the bu
ndled experimental refusal-direction projection enabled. Ordinary choices explicitly disable project
ion. The vector loads once with the model; switching presets applies to the next request without a m
odel reload. Each compatible request includes a current-mode runtime notice, so the assistant can di
stinguish the new setting from earlier replies. Changing projection also changes this prompt suffix;
the prior conversation text remains available. Native KV state is separated by projection mode, and
SSD checkpoint names are partitioned by it.
The projection came unchanged from upstream Strata, not from this plugin's author. It is a model-spe
cific experiment, not a guarantee that every refusal disappears. Disabling it does not undo changes
already baked into an abliterated model. See projection provenance and behavior.
## Tuning and checkpoints
**Save and auto-tune** calls Strata's native **`tune auto --mode thorough`**. Strata owns the search
, resource allocation and presets. The plugin adds model identity, context, KV, transport and projec
tor paths. It does not set numeric worker, PCIe or prefill performance presets. Thorough tuning can
take hours. Failed or cancelled tuning retains the previous result.
After a successful ordinary conversation answer, Strata writes its native session checkpoint to SSD.
The plugin keeps **up to 16 GiB per model**, evicting the checkpoint with the oldest last-use time
first. Files and last-use times survive process restarts and system reboots. On the first conversati
on after loading a model, its matching checkpoint is restored before generation. Strata checks model
and cache identity; incompatible checkpoints are skipped. Its own RAM cache handles further convers
ations while that model stays loaded.
Disk checkpoints work with **FP16/FP16, Q8/Q8 and Q4/Q4** (and legacy Q8/Q4). The fork currently rej
ects mixed KV snapshots; the editor displays that limitation. An individual checkpoint larger than 1
6 GiB is not retained. Restoring KV avoids some repeated prompt processing; model weights still need
loading into RAM/VRAM. No model-switch speed improvement is promised without a workload measurement
loading into RAM/VRAM. No model-switch speed improvement is promised without a workload measurement.
**Purge all cache**, at the top of the provider card, waits for an active answer, stops loaded plugi
n models and removes the plugin-owned cache directory, including SSD checkpoints and native RAM cach
es. Model weights, prepared packs, profiles, tuning presets and DSH chat history are retained. A sub
sequent load rebuilds its caches.
## Runtime and storage
Regular Strata is based on **v0.2.7 / Control 0.1.52 / engine 0.1.52**. Both bundled engines include
a small native checkpoint fix for models without an allocated MTP draft. Their source patches, upst
ream revisions, licenses and binary checksums are under `vendor/`. The Gyro L fork also includes its
recorded TQP CPU changes. These engines were built for the tested sm_120 machine; HIP, SYCL, Window
s and other CUDA architectures were not tested.
